blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution questioned on Tuesday why Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense presented city assessors instead of Registry of Deeds officials to prove that disputed properties were declared in her statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs). Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, prosecution spokesperson, said city assessors handle property assessments for taxation, while Registry of Deeds officials maintain records of land ownership. “If the defense intention really is to prove that the vice president did not misdeclare or underdeclare some of her property, it should not be the city assessors to come here and be witnesses,” Alonto Adiong said […]...
